name: Anna Lindström
title: Lead Computer Vision Engineer
summary: Lead Computer Vision Engineer with 10+ years of experience building production-grade perception systems for robotics, industrial inspection, and edge AI. Strong track record of translating research into reliable products, leading cross-functional teams, and improving model accuracy, latency, and deployment efficiency at scale.

bullets: Lead a team of 6 engineers delivering computer vision pipelines for industrial quality inspection across 14 production lines.
Reduced false reject rates by 28% by redesigning defect detection models in Python using PyTorch and OpenCV.
Built an edge deployment stack with TensorRT that cut inference latency from 120 ms to 38 ms on embedded GPU hardware.
Established data labeling, evaluation, and monitoring workflows that improved model release velocity by 40%.
Developed perception modules for mobile robots, combining stereo depth, object detection, and tracking to achieve 96% navigation success in pilot deployments.
Optimized training and inference pipelines, reducing GPU training time by 35% and enabling weekly model iterations.
Partnered with hardware and systems teams to integrate camera calibration and sensor fusion into production robots deployed at 20+ customer sites.
Implemented image segmentation and defect classification systems for manufacturing clients, increasing automated inspection coverage from 55% to 87%.
Created reusable Python tooling for dataset preparation, experiment tracking, and evaluation, lowering manual analysis time by 60%.
Collaborated with product managers and field engineers to validate prototypes and convert them into customer-facing solutions.
Built early machine learning prototypes for video analytics and anomaly detection, improving event detection precision by 22%.
Supported deployment and testing of computer vision services in Linux-based environments, including scripting in Python for data ingestion and model validation.
Contributed to cross-functional proof-of-concept work that informed two commercial product launches.

education.degree: MSc in Computer Science, Specialization in Machine Learning
